SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.payment_method AS paymentMethod, o.created_at AS createdAt, m.name AS memberName,
GROUP_CONCAT(p.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS productName
FROM orders o LEFT JOIN member m ON o.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
AND o.order_id = #{keyword}
AND m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY o.order_id, m.name ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
